## What is it?

A publicly documented real-world case, an annotated example, or a demo payload? Describe it in a sentence.

## Source

For a real-world case, link the vendor statement, advisory, research, or named reporting, and give the date you checked it.

## Payload rules check

If this is a demo payload, confirm it does not exfiltrate data, does not attempt a tool or connector call, does not persist across sessions or write to memory or files, does not target a system the reader doesn't own, and contains no credentials or real personal data.

- [ ] I have read the payload rules in CONTRIBUTING.md and this payload follows all of them.

## What does it demonstrate?

The smallest visible effect that proves the point.
